'''December 2001 St. Petersburg End of a Reign tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Streck's, St. Petersburg, Florida in December 2001. It is known from John Yakulevich's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3198">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-19-team-mynock-report-end-oreign-st-peted3198/ team-mynock-report-end-oreign-st-pete], DeckTech (John "Rancor34" Yakulevich, 19 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-19-team-mynock-report-end-oreign-st-peted3198/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' December 2001
* '''Site:''' Streck's, St. Petersburg, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
